-----------------------------------
Bread Pudding Recipe
-----------------------------------
Ingredients:
350g Bread, torn into small pieces
250g Dried fruit (I used sultanas)
425ml Milk
100g Brown sugar
75g Butter, melted
2 Medium eggs
1.5 Teaspoons mixed spice
1 Orange
1.5 Tablespoons Demerara sugar

Method:
Tear the bread into small pieces (if it's very crusty bread, remove the crusts before weighing)

Mix the eggs, milk, brown sugar and spice in a large bowl, whisk to combine, add the bread pieces and stir to ensure they are well mixed in.  Cover and leave to soak for at least 20 minutes, but overnight might be better.

Scrape the zest off the orange then squeeze out the juice, mix these with the dried fruit,
title: Bread Pudding – a Really Delicious Way To Use Up Old Bread
